```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-IDg
#| tbl-cap: "Slope configurations representative of tailings storage facilities (TSF) and waste rock dumps (WRD) used in Newmark displacement and fundamental-period analyses."
DT <- ShearTable[,.(IDg,"Hs[m]"=Hs,"b[m]"=b,"s"=round(s,1),lo)]   |> unique()


TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
    library = "flextable",
    align.body = "center",
    font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
    font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
)
TBL <- flextable::set_table_properties(TBL, layout = "autofit")

TBL

```
